population: Development conformance fixtures reconstructed from published Paper II definitions; no external holdout or performance ranking.

catalan.coverage: Every pair of every complete bounded layer, compared at every horizon to the retained full-universe reference; portable exact-threshold proofs/models for every query pair.

replay: Fresh Python process with import guard before checker import; no producer, prototype, search, Java or SMT. Normal and -O.
metrics: Input DAG nodes, represented proof events, models, checked goals, full-layer reference comparisons, certificate bytes. Runtime is recorded only as conformance cost, not a speedup experiment.
failures: Every failed case aborts with a nonzero exit; never discard a failed case or replace an expected profile after observing output. Corrections to code and reruns are development and must be disclosed.
